I’m a trained economist, computer scientist and researcher. As an [independent consultant](../consulting/index.qmd), I work with frontier and open-source AI models, APIs and harnesses to solve complex challenges faced by organizations. As a researcher, I have challenged long-standing paradigms in explainable AI, developed novel methods to make AI more trustworthy and criticized hyperbolic claims about AGI. I am an open-sourve advocate and the founder:{width=""} and maintainer of ([Taija](www.taija.org))--an ecosystem of packages for Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence in Julia.

Previously, I worked as an economist for [Bank of England](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk){target="_blank"} where I was involved in research, monetary policy, market intelligence and software development. I hold a Ph.D. from [Delft University of Technology](https://www.tudelft.nl/), two masters degrees from [Barcelona School of Economics](https://bse.eu){target="_blank"} in data science and economics and finance, and an undergraduate degree in economics from the [University of Edinburgh](https://www.ed.ac.uk){target="_blank"}.
